premises.text: Formal curricula lag the job market, leaving large numbers of African graduates without competitive tech skills
premises.evidence_span: The Nigerian education system did not prepare me for today's job market

premises.text: A one-year program delivers structured learning, soft skills, mentorship, and a three-month internship with African-made content
premises.evidence_span: Through our one-year learning program, you gain access to nine months of structured learning, soft skill training, mentorship, and three months of internship

premises.text: Entry is cost-effective versus bootcamps and open to SSE-certificate holders
premises.evidence_span: All School Africa is a sure path, cost-effective way towards accessing online education within a period of one year

premises.text: Revenue mixes a small application fee, low tuition bands, free access, and income-sharing after students get jobs
premises.evidence_span: We accept an application fee of $20. Meanwhile, students get to pay tuition for as little as $50 to $500 over a period of their training. And they can also access education for free. Until they are done, they get a job and then pay back through our income sharing agreement

premises.text: Expansion into Francophone Africa is required for an all-Africa remit beyond Anglophone markets
premises.evidence_span: tap into the Francophone market, which remains untapped

value.text: Give every African accessible technical skills to compete on a global scale
value.evidence_span: ensure that every African has access to such opportunities, such that they can compete on a global scale

secondary_value.text: Support learners from coding start through career progression
